newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume jumps, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume jumps, prices mixed.

text.p: Volume leaped to 830 kilos on the Istanbul Gold Exchange on Friday from 495 kilos on Thursday on rising demand ahead of the weekend, while prices closed mixed, traders said.
Gold eased slightly to $369.70 an ounce from $369.80 on Thursday, but jumped to 1,266,800 lira per gram from 1,260,500 due to a weaker lira on the domestic currency market.
Morning trade totalled 400 kilos with 430 done in the afternoon. The traders said 60.2 percent of the turnover was in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75
